escena: SCENE (cinematic, epic, high-impact editorial photograph, a dark film set at night with thin haze): Nexa, wearing the ROYAL-BLUE EFEONCE HOODIE, stands on the RIGHT side of the frame, framed from the waist up; the shoulder nearest the left edge of the frame is at about 58 % of the frame width and a wide band of empty darkness runs between the left edge of the frame and her body; camera about four meters away at chest height, 85mm f/2, REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS. THE MOMENT: with the hand on the frame-right side of her body she holds a modern matte black clapperboard out to her side at lower-chest height, at about 80 % of the frame width, clear of her chest so the mark on her hoodie stays fully visible, in front of the phone and turned toward it: the camera sees only the plain black BACK of the slate, and its written face is turned away and never visible; its hinged stick is open in a V, about to clap, with plain black-and-white diagonal stripes; no chalk, no text and no numbers anywhere on it. Behind the clapperboard on the frame-right, a little farther from the camera, at about 92 % of the frame width, a plain matte black phone stands VERTICAL on a tripod, its back toward the camera, blank, with no logo, and beside it one slim LED tube light stands upright, glowing clean cool white with a hair-thin azure-blue (#0375DB) edge; on top of the phone rig glows one tiny crisp orange (#FF6500) recording dot, the only accent in the frame, which lights nothing around it. She is about to call the take: a sure, energetic half-smile; head almost frontal, only her eyes turn toward the clapperboard on the frame-right; she does not look toward the dark left side of the frame. The LED tube is the only key light and lights her face from the frame-right at head height, cool white; both eyes stay readable, with a catchlight. Her hand is small and slender, in natural proportion to her face; the hoodie cuff covers her wrist down to the base of the palm: no watch and no bracelet; the fingers of that hand are bare; her ring is on her other hand, which rests inside the hoodie pocket. The matte black lid of an equipment case stands between the camera and her, its near edge just in front of the lens; it is non-reflective and outside every light. The clapperboard, the phone, the tube and everything lit stay inside the RIGHT half of the frame. The left half of the frame is the plain unlit black backdrop of the set: no lamps, no screens and no bokeh points on it. Nobody looks toward the dark left side of the frame. No warm light, no readable text, no logos of any other brand.
